checkpoints.description: [1/2] Implement the SU(7)_1163 block SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)^2 gauge subsector and exact coset central charge

impact_assessment.benefits: Turns the abstract coset possibility into an explicit subgroup/level calculation and quantifies the large unexplained sector that remains.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pre-register the standard index-one SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)^2 block embedding, levels 1163/1163 and exact central charges in ADR-071; compute c_sub=8812057/679195 and c_coset=920175833/26488605; independently audit the arithmetic; avoid claims about dynamics or spectrum.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new block-subsector checks and audit row change fingerprints; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: source, tests, reports and docs; physics: embedding indices, U(1) normalization and SM gauge mixing are not derived, and the coset is not identified with known matter.
impact_assessment.why: Claim 72 excludes conformal SM embedding but not ordinary subgroup embedding. The standard 3+2+1+1 block decomposition of SU(7) provides a concrete non-conformal SM gauge subsector and a precise remaining coset.
